cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import sys,json,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
import fuzz
rng=random.Random(99)
ops=fuzz.gen_case(rng, style='deep', nputs=200)
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(o[0] for o in ops))
print('queries', sum(len(o[1]) for o in ops if o[0] in ('query','image_query')))
print('saves', sum(1 for o in ops if o[0]=='save'), 'loads', sum(1 for o in ops if o[0].startswith('load')))
"
